content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric utility serving households and businesses over owned networks, matching the target's electric distribution, though it adds telecom."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility; it distributes water rather than natural gas, electricity or propane."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Upstream gas producer and power plant owner selling to wholesale buyers, not a regional distributor to homes and businesses."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Contract construction and maintenance services for utilities, not owning and delivering energy to end customers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Regulated gas and electric delivery utility serving homes and businesses over its own networks, matching the target's core model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale distributor of plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors, a different product and customer base."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Retail and delivery propane distributor serving homes and businesses with propane, cylinders and appliance services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Electrical contractor installing building systems for construction projects, not a utility delivering energy to customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gathering and processing for oil and gas producers, selling to petrochemical and export buyers rather than end customers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility; it sells water service rather than natural gas, electricity or propane."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner selling gasoline, jet fuel and asphalt, with a different product and value chain from the target."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Propane distributor delivering fuel to homes and businesses through branches, sharing the target's propane and customer model."}]}
